Macan
Electro

Macan Electric

Coupé-like lines, a low front end and sporty proportions form the dynamic, progressive design DNA of the Macan Electric. The gently rising bonnet and the strongly contoured fenders give the SUV a powerful and sporty appearance. The width of the front end is emphasised by the flat upper light cluster with four-point daytime running lights integrated into the fenders. The LED main headlights are positioned slightly lower in the front end. The sporty flyline spans the frameless doors with the Macan’s characteristic sideblades and ends at the flat rear window. Short overhangs and an extended wheelbase underline the promise of performance. Prominent shoulders alongside the adaptive rear spoiler give the rear view a particularly muscular appearance. Beneath this runs a continuous 3D light strip featuring three-dimensional Porsche lettering in a glass-effect finish. The diffuser provides a harmonious visual finish to the lower edge of the rear bumper.

Gasoline

Macan

The Macan is the sports car among compact SUVs. Its sporting pedigree is immediately apparent in its design. The Sport Utility Vehicle sits low and wide on the road. The front end emphasises the Macan’s width and reinforces its sporty character. The LED headlamps are fitted with the Porsche Dynamic Light System (PDLS). The sweeping bonnet and the gently sloping roofline underline the overall impression of sporty elegance and powerful dynamism. Familiar design elements from Porsche sports cars are integrated into the Macan in a further-developed form. On the flanks of the vehicle, the 3D-style sideblades add distinctive accents. The designers have arranged the rear lights, with their three-dimensional graphics, in a continuous light strip. The diffuser, which extends upwards, features integrated reflectors. Like the front end, the lower section of the rear also features a refined and technical design.
